mapper.select: SELECT cp.room_id, cp.user_id, cp.is_admin, cp.joined_at, cp.last_read_at, cp.notifications_enabled, CASE WHEN sp.student_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(u.name, '/', sp.student_id) WHEN pp.professor_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(u.name, '/', pp.professor_id) WHEN st.staff_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(u.name, '/', st.staff_id) WHEN ap.assistant_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(u.name, '/', ap.assistant_id) ELSE u.name END as nickname FROM chat_participants cp JOIN users u ON cp.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN student_profiles sp ON u.id = sp.user_id LEFT JOIN professor_profiles pp ON u.id = pp.user_id LEFT JOIN staff_profiles st ON u.id = st.user_id LEFT JOIN assistant_profiles ap ON u.id = ap.user_id WHERE cp.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY cp.joined_at ASC
SELECT cp.room_id, cp.user_id, cp.nickname, cp.is_admin, cp.joined_at, cp.last_read_at, cp.notifications_enabled FROM chat_participants cp WHERE cp.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT cp.room_id, cp.user_id, cp.nickname, cp.is_admin, cp.joined_at, cp.last_read_at, cp.notifications_enabled FROM chat_participants cp WHERE cp.room_id = #{roomId} AND cp.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_participants WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM chat_participants WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND user_id = #{userId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_participants (room_id, user_id, nickname, is_admin, joined_at, notifications_enabled) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{userId}, #{nickname}, #{isAdmin}, #{joinedAt}, 1)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat_participants WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND user_id = #{userId}
